# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best: 20 LUTs, 20 FFs, four DSP48s, WNS 0.105 ns, and WHS 0.18 ns; it passed simulation and the reported promotion gates. Timing is closed, so iteration 2 must strictly reduce LUTs (or tie LUTs and reduce FFs) to improve the `minimize_luts` objective.

## Hypothesis
Expressing the four products as a DSP48 multiply-accumulate cascade may absorb pair-sum logic into DSP arithmetic and reduce LUT use while preserving the two-stage pipeline.

## Instruction for generator
In `elastic_dot4_core`, replace the separate `product_0`–`product_3` wires and pair-sum additions with explicit unsigned multiply-accumulate expressions for the two 17-bit stage-1 partial sums, using `use_dsp = "yes"` on those accumulator expressions so Vivado can map the additions into DSP48 arithmetic. Keep the existing stage-1 and stage-2 registers, valid/ready logic, reset behavior, and 18-bit final sum unchanged; retain the top’s `// @latency 2` annotation. Preserve all four unsigned products and carry bits, and rely on routed reports to establish whether LUT use actually falls while both timing slacks remain nonnegative.
